critique: The stained halftone kettle, tiny red flag, green toy spoons, torn primary-colour fields, and mismatched ransom-note numerals create a boldly high-key, genuinely absurd Neo-Dada collision. The guinea pig is reduced to an effectively invisible 18-pixel speck, so enlarging or fragmenting it into the kettle collage would make the source-image juxtaposition meaningfully surprising rather than merely nominal.
